shortDescription: Framework for entad items: randomly rolled traits by rarity that modify stats, damage, abilities and buildings, stay hidden until revealed, and make every entad more durable by its highest rarity.
body:
## Durability
- Every item with at least one entad trait gets its MaxHitPoints multiplied by `EntadSettings.Durability[highest trait rarity]`. Defaults: Common x1.25, Uncommon x1.5, Rare x2, Epic x3, Legendary x5. Each is adjustable from 1 to 10 in the settings (General tab), and "Reset to defaults" covers them. Applied last in `StatPart_Entad.TransformValue`, never hidden.
- HP keeps its health fraction on trait add/remove (`RescaleHitPoints`), when the settings window closes mid-game, and on load (`SyncDurability` against saved `scaledDurability`). A full-health item snaps to the new maximum.
- MaxHitPoints is always injected but stays immutable; every real change calls `ClearCacheForThing`.

## Furniture mood (EntadMoods.cs)
- Prefix on `Pawn_JobTracker.CleanupCurrentJob`, player-faction humanlikes only. The job's targetA building counts as used when:
  - work or recreation: a bill, Research, OperateDeepDrill/OperateScanner, or any job with a joyKind (modded recreation included, e.g. DBH baths); or
  - own use (`IsOwnUse`): the job has no workGiverDef (needs, rituals, direct non-work orders: toilets, showers, thrones, comms consoles, deathrest caskets), the pawn isn't in a mental state, and the job isn't on the exclusion list (attack, ignite, open, strip, mine, deconstruct, uninstall, repair, fix, refuel, flick, haul-to-container, beat fire, hack, relic extraction, carry to entity holder/portal).
  - and the job Succeeded, the pawn is on the interaction cell, or the pawn is inside the footprint (not beds).
- Every WorkGiver job carries workGiverDef (JobGiver_Work and right-click work orders), which is how hauling/repair/refuel/cleaning are kept out.
- Chairs: sittable building under the pawn after a meal that Succeeded, or for work/joy at a building (on its interaction cell, or a completed job at one without, e.g. TV).
- Beds: `pawn.CurrentBed()` for LayDown / LayDownAwake / LayDownResting / Lovin.
- Tables: the eating surface after a Succeeded Ingest.
- Stacking: `Thought_EntadFurniture` records the building's `thingIDNumber` (`entadSourceId`). The same building renews its own memory; different sources stack to stackLimit (Contentment 3). At the cap the oldest non-equipped memory of that thought (furniture, or a plain game-event copy) is replaced; equipped-item memories are never displaced.

## Random mood traits (Fickle Cheer, +2 to +8)
- `MoodCandidates`: every loaded ThoughtDef (all mods, built on first use) that is a plain memory (`ThoughtClass == Thought_Memory`), single visible stage, no required traits/genes, no nextThought/thoughtToMake, label/description without `{`/`[`, not nullified by Psychopath, mood within thoughtMoodRange.

## Wearer stats (EntadWearerStats.cs)
- Offsets reach the holder through a postfix on `StatWorker.StatOffsetFromGear`; `StatPart_Entad` skips them on apparel/equipment. Offsets display unfinalized (`Worker.ValueToString(v,false,Offset)`). "Relevant gear" lists only items with a non-zero revealed offset.

## Hiding unrevealed traits in displays
Gameplay always applies every trait. Thread-static flags (`displayExcludesHidden`, `gearCardThing`, `infoCardThing`) make displays leave hidden ones out. Hidden traits add the flat "unidentified" market value.

## Startup
- `EntadCompInjector` (comp + `MayHaveComp` table), `EntadStatPartInjector` (StatPart on referenced stats + MarketValue + MaxHitPoints, then each Harmony class in its own try/catch), `EntadAbilityPrep` (per-trait ability copies with own hashes, null-safe reflection).

## Save compatibility
- `Patch_BackCompatibleDefName`: RapidCycling/Stormfeed → HairTrigger, AcceleratedRounds → HeavySlugs, BrutalEdge → HeavyHitter, Parrying → Evasion, MarksmansEye → SteadyHands, BlessedComfort → SoothingPresence.
- `AppliedEntadTrait.ExposeData` reads the saved name; on a rename it re-rolls values, thought and meal factor at the saved rarity and clears ability cooldown/charge lists. PostLoadInit removes duplicate traits, keeping the higher rarity and merging reveal state.

## Building properties
- Fuel/glow/power/heat via `CompEntad.PropertyFactor`, `hiddenPropertyMask`. Glow `ForceRegister` only on trait add/remove.

## Weapons
- Extra damage via `Projectile.Impact` and `Bullet.Impact` postfixes. Searing: Burn 1–4 (Uncommon, scales). Cinderstrike: Flame 4–10, Epic. Frostbite: 2–6 (Rare).

## Reveal triggers, Meals, API
- Reveal triggers check `HasHiddenGear` first; Learn trickle only on the 250-tick hash tick.
- `[ThreadStatic] eating` around `Thing.Ingested`.
- EntadApi never modifies request objects.

## Content
- Labels Title Case in XML. Restful: non-hostile Restful Sigh, 250-tick cast, pain x0.5 for 4 h, once a day.

## Build setup
- net472, Krafs.Rimworld.Ref 1.6.4871 pinned, Lib.Harmony 2.4.1 compile-only; no publicizer. modVersion 1.0.0.

## Open items
- Def hot-reload doesn't re-run the injectors.
- Fickle Cheer: positive event memories (defeated mech cluster, buried in sarcophagus) are in the pool; awaiting user decision.
- Pending: translation keys, Forge Frenzy-style settings tabs.

## Dev tools
- "Add specific Entad trait" lists applicable traits first, then the rest, alphabetically.
